release_slices.name: Current staging release-governance packaging
release_slices.plain_english_purpose: Package the current staging release controls and add a signed, auditable emergency path when isolated QA is genuinely unavailable.
release_slices.purpose: Make the exact staging candidate reviewable and allow degraded-assurance deployment only through owner-signed controller authorization with compensating controls.
release_slices.implementation_summary: Aggregates the current staging release-governance changes relative to origin/master: isolated QA documentation, branch cleanup hardening, readable Regression Risk Notice rendering, and a signed emergency-QA authorization lane in the external controller. The emergency lane remains ineligible for payment-sensitive or migration releases and preserves exact-SHA promotion, local qualification, rollback readiness, production proof, and deployed-change accuracy finalization.
included_features: Readable operator evidence in Regression Risk Notice Markdown
Reviewed release-batch evidence for branch cleanup hardening
Documented isolated QA deferral while preserving production promotion as blocked until QA proof exists
Exact aggregate manifest coverage for the current origin/master..origin/staging candidate
Signed emergency-QA authorization for eligible non-payment, no-migration releases
Hash-bound emergency evidence with controller-local enablement and mandatory post-deploy accuracy
excluded_features: Executing QA against production or treating production as isolated QA
Dirty local Storefront guest-checkout files in the preserved main checkout

documentation_closure.rationale: This release changes the external production authorization boundary by adding a signed emergency lane for unavailable isolated QA. ADR 0030 and the authoritative operational standards are updated together with controller tests and operator evidence requirements.

documents.evidence: Defines the signed emergency-QA lane while preserving staging-to-master promotion, exact origin/master deployment, Regression Risk Notice, and deployed-change accuracy requirements.
Requires exact-SHA QA evidence normally and defines the narrow signed substitution when isolated QA is unavailable.
Authorizes the hash-bound signed emergency-QA controller lane and enumerates its non-bypassable compensating controls.
Confirms local/manual deployment remains branch-reflection and no-staging gated.
Records that isolated QA is deferred and production promotion remains blocked until QA proof exists.
Provides exact reviewed file coverage for the current staging-to-master candidate.

release_slices.adr_or_compliance: ADR 0030 is updated because this cross-boundary change modifies the external signed-controller production authorization contract. Payment authorization remains separate and emergency QA is forbidden for payment-sensitive scope.
release_slices.rollback_notes: Disable emergency_qa_bypass in root-owned controller configuration and revert the controller/ADR change if the lane is rejected. Existing normal isolated-QA releases remain valid.
production_proof_required: origin/master equals the final promoted master SHA
production remote HEAD equals the final promoted master SHA
.deploy-state/last_deployed_commit equals the final promoted master SHA
newest production deploy summary records deployed_head, remote_head, and expected_commit equal to the final promoted master SHA
/api/v1/health services.observability.runtime_sha equals the final promoted master SHA
production_accuracy_checks_required: Regression Risk Notice Markdown renders readable evidence fields instead of object-string output
QA isolation documentation does not overclaim production approval
Branch cleanup hardening remains documentation/tooling only until production proof and deployed-change accuracy review are complete
Current-state docs do not claim this staging candidate is production-live before deploy proof exists
Signed emergency evidence is accepted only when controller configuration enables it and all compensating controls pass
release_slices.regression_warning_summary: This release-governance packaging candidate affects production authorization evidence and could cause unsafe deployment decisions if the aggregate manifest or QA-deferral wording is wrong.

rollback_or_monitoring_notes: Prefer isolated QA. Use emergency QA only through the installed signed controller with the exact hash-bound report and fresh authorization tags.
If promoted incorrectly, revert the master promotion commit and repeat the exact-SHA release gates for the revert SHA.
After any eventual deployment, verify production runtime SHA, deploy summary, remote HEAD, .deploy-state marker, and deployed-change accuracy before branch retirement.
